owner: scripts/pipeline/resolve_identity_entities.py (FL-4876 MANUAL-FIXTURE-02; manual acceptance gate for generic fixtures)
method: Rows without an accepted manual_review are projected review candidates, not authored placements. objects_to_fixtures.py derived their initial module and E/N values from hand-recorded panorama words, image x, estimated distance and heading, then merged nearby rows. Those derivations are evidence-navigation aids only. A row emits no geometry unless manual_review.status is accepted and a person has written the final module_id, E, N, carrier_id, yaw_deg and position_uncertainty_m with separate module, position, carrier and orientation bases after inspecting the source views and map. The resolver never chooses the carrier by nearest distance.
decided_by: source sightings were hand-recorded; every module and placement remains pending individual manual acceptance unless its row contains manual_review.status=accepted
